'''Frank Conaci''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Connecticut State Championship]] on 16 April 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]], according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d533">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00d533/ connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-connnecticut-state-championship-4-16-00d533/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
